fullPassage: Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics found in humans relative to non-humans. Unlike most animals, humans have multilayered societies, although hamadryas baboons (Papio hamadryas hamadryas) and bottle-nosed dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) have layered societies that approach the complexity of that of humans in that there is cooperation between higher-level social units. Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even met, but who are either distant kin or are symbolically connected in some way. Such cooperation would probably be impossible without the aid of language, which enables people to deliver messages to others. * prone to ~할 가능성이 있는 ** conspecific 동일 종 *** hamadryas baboon 망토개코원숭이

questions.passage: Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics found in humans relative to non-humans. Unlike most animals, humans have multilayered societies, although hamadryas baboons (Papio hamadryas hamadryas) and bottle-nosed dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) have layered societies that approach the complexity of that of humans in that there is cooperation between higher-level social units. Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even met, but who are either distant kin or are symbolically connected in some way. Such cooperation would probably be impossible without the aid of __________, which enables people to deliver messages to others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: language(언어): 사람들이 다른 사람에게 메시지를 전달할 수 있게 해주는 도구
det.analysis:
❌ ① cooperation(협력): 빈칸 뒤 'which enables people to deliver messages'의 주어로서 '협력이 메시지 전달을 가능하게 한다'는 부적절
✅ ② language(언어): '언어의 도움 없이는 불가능' + '사람들이 메시지를 전달할 수 있게 하는 것' = 언어가 정확히 일치
❌ ③ society(사회): 'which enables people to deliver messages'와 연결하면 '사회가 메시지 전달을 가능하게 한다'는 간접적이며 본문 맥락에 부적합
❌ ④ complexity(복잡성): '복잡성의 도움 없이'는 문맥상 어색하고, 복잡성이 메시지 전달을 가능하게 한다는 것은 비논리적
det.tip: the aid of language = 언어의 도움. 관계대명사 which의 선행사가 language

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: inclination(성향): 인간이 비인간에 비해 많은 수의 동일 종과 협력하려는 '성향'이 더 크다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① difference(차이): 'social complexity and difference for cooperation'은 'difference for ~'가 어색하고, 복잡성과 차이를 병렬하는 것이 의미상 부적합
❌ ② isolation(고립): '협력을 위한 고립'은 모순. 협력과 고립은 반대 개념
✅ ③ inclination(성향): 'social complexity and inclination for cooperation' = 사회적 복잡성과 협력 성향. 인간이 비인간보다 크다는 문맥과 정확히 일치
❌ ④ restriction(제한): '협력을 위한 제한'은 의미상 부적합. 제한은 협력을 방해하는 요소
det.tip: inclination for = ~에 대한 성향/경향. complexity와 병렬 구조

questions.passage: Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics ①<u>found</u> in humans relative to non-humans. Unlike most animals, humans have multilayered societies, although hamadryas baboons (Papio hamadryas hamadryas) and bottle-nosed dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) have layered societies that approach the complexity of that of humans in that there is cooperation between ②<u>higher-level</u> social units. Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to ③<u>that</u> there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even met, but who are either distant kin or are symbolically connected in some way. Such cooperation would probably be impossible without the aid of language, which ④<u>enables</u> people to deliver messages to others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ that → which: 'the extent to which'는 관계대명사 which가 전치사 to의 목적어로 쓰인 구문
det.analysis:
✅ ① found: conspecifics found in humans — 과거분사가 conspecifics를 수식. '인간에게서 발견되는 동종'이므로 적절
✅ ② higher-level: higher-level social units — 복합형용사가 명사 수식, 적절
❌ ③ that → which: 'in the extent to ___ there is cooperation' — 전치사 to + 관계대명사 구문에서 that은 전치사 뒤에 올 수 없음. to which가 올바른 형태
✅ ④ enables: language, which enables people — 관계대명사절의 동사. 선행사 language(단수)에 맞는 3인칭 단수 enables 적절
det.tip: 전치사 + 관계대명사: to which / in which / of which (that은 전치사 뒤 불가)

questions.passage: ①<u>Assuming</u> that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics found in humans relative to non-humans. Unlike most animals, humans have multilayered societies, although hamadryas baboons (Papio hamadryas hamadryas) and bottle-nosed dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) have layered societies that ②<u>approach</u> the complexity of that of humans in that there is cooperation between higher-level social units. Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even ③<u>met</u>, but who are either distant kin or are symbolically ④<u>connecting</u> in some way. Such cooperation would probably be impossible without the aid of language, which enables people to deliver messages to others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ connecting → connected: 'are symbolically connected'는 수동태로 '상징적으로 연결되어 있는' 상태를 나타냄
det.analysis:
✅ ① Assuming: 분사구문 'Assuming that ~'으로 '~라고 가정하면'의 의미. 능동 분사 적절
✅ ② approach: 'societies that approach the complexity' — 주격 관계대명사절 동사. 주어 societies(복수)에 맞는 복수형 적절
✅ ③ met: 'have not even met' — 현재완료 부정문. met은 meet의 과거분사 적절
❌ ④ connecting → connected: 'are symbolically ___' — be + p.p. 수동태 구문. '상징적으로 연결되어 있는' 상태이므로 과거분사 connected 필요. connecting은 능동/진행으로 의미 부적합
det.tip: be connected = 연결되어 있다 (수동/상태). be connecting = 연결하는 중이다 (능동/진행)

questions.passage: Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? ( ③ ) Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even met, but who are either distant kin or are symbolically connected in some way. questions.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? "This sets humans apart from all other species in terms of cooperative behavior."

det.korean: ④: 직전 문장이 '서로 거의 모르는 개인 간에도 협력한다'는 인간의 독특한 점을 설명한 뒤, 삽입 문장이 그 독특함을 정리
det.analysis:
❌ ① 질문 직후: 아직 답변이 시작되지 않았으므로 '인간을 구별한다'는 정리 문장이 올 위치가 아님
❌ ② 사회적 복잡성 설명 직후: 아직 다층적 사회 비교가 나오지 않아 'sets apart'의 근거 부족
❌ ③ 망토개코원숭이/돌고래 비교 직후: 이 비교는 인간과 비슷한 동물을 제시한 것이지 '인간만의 독특함'을 보여준 것이 아님
✅ ④ 인간의 독특한 협력 설명 직후: 'This'가 그 독특한 협력을 가리키며 'sets humans apart from all other species'가 자연스러운 요약
det.tip: This sets ~ apart = 이것이 ~를 구별짓는다. 앞 문장의 핵심 내용을 가리킴

questions.passage: ① Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? ② One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics found in humans relative to non-humans. ③ Unlike most animals, humans have multilayered societies, although hamadryas baboons and bottle-nosed dolphins have layered societies that approaches the complexity of that of humans. ④ Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even met, but who are either distant kin or are symbolically connected in some way.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 문장은?

③.find: approach the complexity of that of humans in that there is cooperation between higher-level social units
③.display: approaches the complexity of that of humans

det.korean: ③ approaches → approach: 관계대명사 that의 선행사가 societies(복수)이므로 동사도 복수형 approach
det.analysis:
✅ ① Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms... — 분사구문 + 비교급 구문, 문법 적절
✅ ② One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity... — may lie in(~에 있을 수 있다) 정상
❌ ③ societies that approaches → societies that approach: 관계대명사 that의 선행사가 layered societies(복수). approaches(단수)는 주어-동사 수 불일치
✅ ④ Humans are ... probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation... — 문법 적절
det.tip: 관계대명사절 동사의 수는 선행사에 일치: societies(복수) → approach

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: multilayered(다층적인): 인간 사회의 특징으로, 뒤에 나오는 'layered societies'와 대비되는 더 복잡한 층위
det.analysis:

questions.passage: Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? ❌ ② unnecessary(불필요한): 언어 없이 협력이 '불필요하다'는 것은 글의 논지와 반대
❌ ③ guaranteed(보장된): '언어 없이 보장된다'는 글의 논지 반대
❌ ④ beneficial(유익한): '언어 없이 유익하다'는 문맥과 맞지 않음
det.tip: would probably be impossible without = ~없이는 아마 불가능할 것이다
